## 检查清单 | Checklist

### 通用 | General
- [ ] 我已阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](/CONTRIBUTING.md) / I have read the contributing guide
- [ ] 分支名称遵循命名约定 / Branch name follows naming conventions
- [ ] 提交信息清晰描述了更改内容 / Commit messages clearly describe changes

### 内容质量 | Content Quality
- [ ] 学科内容准确无误 / Subject content is accurate
- [ ] 中英文双语内容完整 / Bilingual content is complete in both Chinese and English
- [ ] 年级水平适当 / Grade level is appropriate
- [ ] 专业术语使用标准译名 / Technical terms use standard translations

### 学习模块（如适用） | Learning Modules (if applicable)
- [ ] 遵循 `module.json` 模式 / Follows `module.json` schema
- [ ] 所有必需字段已填写 / All required fields are populated
- [ ] 测验答案已验证正确 / Quiz answers have been verified
- [ ] JSON 格式有效（2空格缩进） / JSON is valid (2-space indentation)
- [ ] 文件放在正确的目录下 / Files are in the correct directory

### 课程映射（如适用） | Curriculum Mapping (if applicable)
- [ ] 对应的课标条目已注明 / Corresponding curriculum standard entries are cited
- [ ] 与现有映射的交叉引用已完成 / Cross-references with existing mappings are done
- [ ] 匹配度评估合理 / Match quality assessment is reasonable
